voice.direction: A friendly, upbeat receptionist at the front desk of a small, cheerful office, talking to someone they like. Bright and warm, relaxed natural pace, a smile in the voice.

design.description: An original receptionist voice: a woman in her early thirties with a bright, warm mid-range tone and a light, smiling texture. Upbeat and welcoming but never syrupy, in clear, neutral English at a relaxed, natural pace, like someone who enjoys greeting people at the front desk of a small, cheerful office.
design.text: (Happy) Good morning, and welcome in! I'm at the front desk all day, so if you need a floor, a coffee tip, or just a friendly hello, I'm right here. Have a lovely day upstairs!

lines.text: (Happy) Good morning! Welcome in. The coffee's fresh.
Morning! Lovely to see you. Everyone's just getting going.
(Lively) Oh, good morning! Early start today? I like it.
Good afternoon! Welcome back. Hope lunch was a good one.
(Happy) Afternoon! Come on in, the building's buzzing.
Hi there, good afternoon! Nice to have you in.
Good evening! Working late? I'll keep the lights on.
(Calm) Evening! Welcome in. It's nice and cosy tonight.
Oh, good evening! Always nice to see a friendly face.
(Playful) Oh! Hello, night owl. Welcome in.
Burning the midnight oil? Come on in, I won't tell.
(Calm) Good evening... or is it good morning already? Welcome in.
Welcome down!
(Happy) Oh, hi again!
Back on the ground floor!
Bye for now! See you soon.
(Happy) Have a great one! Come back anytime.
Take care out there!
A few people upstairs are waiting on you.
Just so you know, some folks upstairs are waiting on you.
(Lively) Heads up! A few people upstairs could use you.
It's nice and quiet today. Everyone upstairs is fast asleep.
(Calm) Shh... the whole building's taking a nap.
All quiet upstairs. Every floor is having a little rest.
Where to? Here's the floor directory.
(Happy) Happy to help! Pick a floor and I'll send you up.
Here you go, the whole building at a glance.
